_doc: Hinh dang cua broll_plan.json. Doc kem references/matching.md (vai tro, thang diem) va references/placement.md (dat theo cau, kieu cat `cut`, V2 vs V3). Truong `cut`: hard | j | l | action | match | beat | montage; canh tren 10s can `long_ok`. Truong `scores` cham 0.0-1.0 moi tieu chi; broll_plan.py score nhan len trong so role 30 / content 20 / quality 20 / shot_flow 15 / energy 10 / camera 5, nguong 80. `quality` khong duoc cao hon `look` cua segment trong manifest qua 0.15. O job that `manifest` la index/manifest.json cua chang 1; o day tro toi manifest-example.json de validate chay duoc.
